_comment: Single source of truth for tracked products. The daily routine reads this file instead of hardcoding the list in its prompt. Matching philosophy: match by PRODUCT IDENTITY (name/manufacturer/weight), not literal barcode equality — retailers sometimes register the same physical product under different EANs.

products.name: טונה סטארקיסט בשמן 4X160 גרם
products.notes: same physical product (טונה בשמן סטארקיסט, 640g, ת. ישראל) registered under different EANs per chain — confirmed by name/manufacturer/weight, not barcode

products.name: ביצים L (מנורמל ל-12 יח')
products.notes: osherad = ביצים 18 יח' בינוני (18-count medium); shufersal = ביצים ארוזות XL 12 יחידות (12-count XL) — closest equivalent available at each chain

products.name: תפוח עץ פינק ליידי 1 ק"ג
products.notes: osherad = תפוח עץ פינק (ת. ישראל); shufersal = תפוח עץ פינקליידי ארה"ב* — both weighted/priced per kg, country of origin differs but same tracked product line

products.name: גבינה צהובה 9% פרוסות 200 גרם
products.notes: Clean exact match found after checking every fat-percentage tier: osherad = פרוסות גבינה נעם 9%, shufersal = גבינת עמק 9% פרוס 200 גר — identical format (sliced box), identical weight (200g), identical fat % (9%), both actively sold. This is a genuinely equivalent product, unlike the 28% tier where no matching packaged format exists on both sides (osherad only sells 28% as a plain 500g block or a cheap unrelated Polish import; osherad's own עמק 28% listing is stale — no sale since June 2026). No normalization needed — same pack size both sides.
